content:
tara: Drafting a compact manager kickoff checklist for the first week + 30/60/90 expectations. Trying to keep it very actionable and manager-friendly. Can folks skim and flag gaps?

kevin: Skimming. Looks solid. One add: schedule a customer shadow or support ridealong around week 2 for context.

tara: Good idea, @kevin. Will add customer shadow to Week 2. Also planning to make security/compliance training have a 48h completion target.

indra: Please include the benefits/payroll link in the template. Canonical page: https://companywiki/internal/benefits. Also note: payroll enrollment required within first 3 business days.

mike: Can we add a short engineering unblock checklist managers can share? Quick snippet below.

```
Dev quickstart (to give to new hires):
- Request access: monorepo, CI, infra dashboards
- Clone + install: git clone git@repo:org/infra.git && make bootstrap
- Run tests: ./ci/run_local_tests.sh
- Join #eng-dev for install help
```

kevin: Also add a reminder to schedule the new hire skip-level within week 1 for visibility.

tara: OK here's the condensed checklist I'm proposing. After edits I'll push to Notion and the manager email template.

```
Manager kickoff: first-week condensed checklist
Pre-start (Week0):
- Open IT ticket for laptop, VPN, SSO
- Assign buddy and add to calendar
- Share role doc, OKRs, team roadmap links
- Prepare Day 1 calendar: HR runthrough, team intro, tech setup
Day 1:
- 30m HR: payroll, benefits, policies
- 15m team intro + add to roster
- Dev env kickoff + access verification with buddy
- Set recurring 1:1s (manager->new hire) + schedule skip-level
By EOW (Day5):
- New hire can run tests locally and open a PR
- Manager assigns a small initial deliverable (doc/bug/triage)
- Draft 30/60/90 shared and discussed
- Security/compliance training scheduled and started (complete within 48h)
Week 2:
- Customer shadow / support ridealong
- Stakeholder intro meetings (product/ops/sales as relevant)
- Checkpoint: dev env & tooling fully functional
30/60/90 expectations (manager-owned):
- 30 days: onboarding tasks complete, first small feature or fix delivered, feedback loop established
- 60 days: cross-team collaboration, measurable contribution to roadmap
- 90 days: shipping meaningful work, propose next-quarter goal, calibration with manager
```

indra: Suggest pinning the benefits/payroll link in the Notion template for easy access.

mike: +1. Also propose a 1:1 agenda template for the manager->new-hire kickoff: expectations, communication preferences, immediate blockers, three-week goals.

kevin: :thumbsup: Mention mandatory compliance certs where applicable.

onboard-bot: Reminder: Day 1 checklist will be emailed to hiring manager and buddy 24h before start.

tara: Thanks all  I'll incorporate (customer shadow, pinned links, 1:1 agenda, compliance note) and publish. @indra please confirm payroll wording once updated.

indra: Confirmed. Tweaked wording pushed.

kevin: Looks good. Thanks @tara and team.

tara: Publishing now. If anyone wants role-specific variants (infra/support/sales managers) DM me and Ill create them.

mike: Will do for infra.
_notes: Slack thread export: messages concatenated in chronological order. No title field per agents.md. Keep messages short and realistic; include mentions, emoji, code blocks for snippets.
